pr_title: Fix queued snapshot assignments after partial snapshot fails due to delete
pr_body:
We can't just assume that snapshot after snapshot is assigned right,
we must re-compute the right node or whether or not the shard even
exists still.

closes #86724

review_comments: No big change here really, just extracted the code that re-computes where to run the snapshot since we don't need to do the `isQueued` check twice and used it here.

This was broken before, the shard isn't assigned so it must not move to `INIT`
=> since there's no other shards the snapshot must complete right away as well.
